scope: Post-outcome developmental application of the unchanged reliability-gate formulation to four dataset groups and five target families. It is not confirmation and cannot authorize integration.
replicate_alignment: Five replicate positions are paired across all target families; dataset-specific seed values identify the same positions.
roster_rule: Restrict every historical and new panel to the exact common ten-backbone intersection before computing features, rankings, or outcomes.

feature_policy.allowed: OI scores and OI-derived ranks only

candidate_rules.blend: fixed alpha=0.50 ordinal Borda over the complete broad top-10 pool

gate.standardization: training-group mean and population standard deviation
gate.target: broad top-five mean regret minus blend top-five mean regret
gate.decision: blend iff predicted benefit > 0; otherwise broad

bootstrap.unit: joint replicate position across all five target families

decision.primary: upper95 reliability-gate-minus-broad top-five mean utility regret < 0

interpretation: This tests whether adding independent dataset groups stabilizes the previously frozen OI-only gate. No feature, threshold, alpha, or model hyperparameter may be retuned from the earlier two-group analysis.
